options_en: Dictation, cloze listening, use of multiple-choice questions, identifying positive and negative statements.
Summarising, listening to the whole message and applying the background knowledge.
Rearranging the jumbled words into sentences as one listens.
Recitation of poetry, extempore speech, debate and discussions.
